cases.requirement: Validate certificate trust, bind, search, and attribute mapping over StartTLS.
Resolve the supported Active Directory nested-group profile without role inflation.
Refuse authentication and lifecycle promotion for a disabled directory user.
Prevent one tenant connector from resolving or mapping another tenant.
Fail closed, emit a safe degraded fact, and recover through the configured failover target.
Rotate a Vaultix-backed bind credential with overlap and no value in Tessera evidence.
A standard LDAP client binds, searches, and resolves allowed group membership.
A tenant bind cannot search another tenant base DN or infer its entries.
Mutation operations cannot turn the edge into a writable shadow authority.
Revoked sessions and disabled subjects stop binding within the stated propagation window.
Loss of Tessera authority refuses new binds without serving stale password-equivalent data.
TLS-only edge restart preserves configuration revision and accepts clean client reconnects.
Exercise allowed, denied, and step-up-required decisions through the reference proxy.
Preserve the original method, scheme, host, path, and query through authorization.
Strip caller-supplied identity headers before emitting minimal Tessera assertions.
Reject a valid session used against a route owned by another tenant.
Honor revocation without waiting for an unsafe session lifetime.
Dependency loss refuses protected traffic and emits no identity headers.
Complete browser login and reach an allowlisted upstream with the reviewed claims.
Maintain supported websocket traffic under the same policy and session.
Reject forged state, unsafe return targets, and cross-origin mutation attempts.
Prevent host-header or path manipulation from escaping the configured upstream allowlist.
Logout and operator revocation invalidate browser and upstream access.
Dependency loss cannot fall through to an unprotected upstream.
Graph, management payload, blueprint, and runtime schema round-trip without semantic loss.
Simulate success, refusal, cancellation, and dependency-failure outcomes deterministically.
Reject cycles, unreachable stages, missing refusal paths, and unsafe terminals.
Return a typed conflict when the reviewed base revision is stale.
A dependency failure reaches a reviewed refusal or recovery outcome and never an implicit success terminal.
Publish idempotently, verify behavior, and restore the prior revision with audit.
Complete template selection, graph editing, review, and validation without pointer-only interaction.
Authenticate a Tessera workload and resolve a purpose-bound value only inside the authorized operation.
Request safe certificate status and complete renewal without returning its private key.
Reject references outside the workload's tenant, path, purpose, or operation policy.
Find no seeded value in Tessera database, events, API, logs, evidence, or support bundle.
Degrade only the dependent capability and never extend a cached value past policy.
Rotate with overlap, honor revocation/expiry, and preserve an independently documented owner-recovery path.
